name: Marie C.
text: "I am in charge of my own happiness! I am the only one who can change things" — and "not to expect anything" helps maintain joy without resentment. Rebecca's teachings have truly transformed how I approach every day.

name: Rose, M.D.
text: Rebecca's "prescriptions for unhappiness" were transformative for me as a physician. Practices like "no expectation from other people," "who cares," and "peace or drama" shifted my perspective and brought real peace into my life.

name: Helen T.
text: Rebecca's online fitness classes motivated me to renew my exercise habits. Her "upbeat and encouraging" approach improved my balance, flexibility, and overall emotional and physical wellbeing.

name: Pushpa U.
text: "She is the smiling face in a grim crowd" — with so much love and compassion in times of need. Rebecca has a gift for lifting people up when they need it most.

name: Cynthia S.
text: Rebecca provides honest, positive support while "going the extra mile" with genuine care and warmth. She has been an incredible presence in my life.

name: Trish M.
text: What started as personal training became a true friendship and source of inspiration. Her humor and personal connection — plus all the laughter — keep me motivated to show up every single week.

name: Natalie D.
text: Rebecca's classes taught me to embrace each moment, release labels, and realize that personal happiness begins with self-reflection. She helped me found a hiking club that now brings diverse communities together.

name: Gail D.
text: Rebecca demonstrates authentic presence, merging professionalism with joy through her commitment to spiritual principles. She is a true example of living what she teaches.

name: Joyce Shafer
text: Rebecca genuinely listens and makes people feel special and completely safe to be themselves — no perfectionism required. That kind of acceptance is rare and powerful.

name: Judy A.
text: "I've always told Becky that she is my therapist" — because her presence and positive energy dissolve stress and problems like nothing else. I leave every session feeling lighter.

name: Barbara M.
text: Despite aging, Rebecca proved "you can do anything and everything." Thanks to her, I've kept up with my grandchildren and continued activities I thought were behind me.

name: Janice DeM.
text: Rebecca forms meaningful connections with each person while motivating them toward goals they believed were unachievable. She sees potential in you before you see it in yourself.

name: Susan W.
text: Attending Rebecca's happiness class helped me discover blind spots in habits that were contributing to both my professional success and personal unhappiness. Her teachings helped me navigate 2020 with grace.

name: Eileen
text: The foam roller classes provided incredible stress relief during the pandemic. Rebecca's positive energy and sense of humor made exercise not just tolerable — but genuinely enjoyable.
